checks.evidence: Hesap bilgisi güncellendiğinde temsilciye bildirim gönderimi, steps 1-2: a field (e.g. phone number) is updated and the representative receives a notification that the information was updated.

invented: Notifications must be sent to all registered digital addresses except postal address (attributed to NIST SP 800-63B-4 §6), which the requirement does not state (written as an assumption)
Notification failure must not block the main update operation and a failed notification must be logged (error record), which the requirement does not state (written as an assumption)
